properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): a CAUSES edge drawn on the owner's word ("that requirement exists because of the delegation, so the link is true") did not clear unthreaded_cluster. By design, CAUSES and every other review_relations edge are inference edges outside the traceability walk, and GOVERNED_BY would have threaded it. The finding's scope sentence names CONTAINS as unwalked and never names the 13 relation edges the brainstorm and review skills teach, nor which edges DO thread. The report's "the detector does not count a true link" is overturned: the exclusion is deliberate, and the message is the gap
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-09-29, item I13 of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (friction #32, 0.74.0): "The owner's true CAUSES link did not thread the delegation cluster. unthreaded_cluster still reports the delegation decision because CAUSES is not a traceability edge in the walk." Cost: 1 call with no effect. NOT affected: GOVERNED_BY with ruling=parks, drawn earlier from the hardware requirement to the same decision, which did move the graph.

② PRECEDENT: searched in both designs.
- cap:a-finding-describes-the-walk-that-produced-it (realized) rewrote this exact message to state its scope.
- fact:some-edge-types-are-several-relations-split-by-a-property-value... (2026-09-28) is about readings, not the walk.
- No record that the relation vocabulary is invisible to the walk.

③ CANDIDATES:
- (a) a bug: CAUSES should thread;
- (b) deliberate: CAUSES is not a thread, and the modelling should have used GOVERNED_BY;
- (c) the message sends the reader the wrong way;
- (d) the link was not true.

④⑤ MEASURED at 0.74.0, by code read:
- nodes.rs structural_rule lists SATISFIES, DECOMPOSES, CONSTRAINS, ALLOCATED_TO, REALIZES, VERIFIES, GOVERNED_BY, PROVIDES/CONSUMES/DEPENDS_ON/PART_OF_FLOW, DEPLOYED_TO/REQUIRES_RESOURCE, INCLUDES, SCHEDULED_FOR and CALIBRATED_AGAINST. It says: "Inference edges are not here — they are classified as Causal at runtime".
- structure.rs build_network_of keeps only is_traceability_edge.
- So (a) is refuted: the exclusion is the design. A decision that shapes why a requirement exists is GOVERNED_BY ("Source node is shaped or constrained by a target Decision"), which the owner's sentence also states, so (b) holds and (d) is not needed.
- heal.rs's unthreaded_cluster message says "CONTAINS is not a traceability edge" and lists unwalked node kinds. It names neither the unwalked relation edges nor the edges that thread, so (c) holds.

⑥ CLASS: a scope sentence that names what it excludes by a partial list. The reader infers that everything unlisted counts. The same shape as the parks and level-spine findings of this triage: the words stop one item short. A fix at the class states the INCLUDED set (the traceability edges, by name, from structural_rule itself) rather than a hand-kept excluded list, so the next new edge type cannot drift.

⑦⑧ OWED: a failing-first test that the unthreaded_cluster message is generated from structural_rule's set, or names it, then the words.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether a CAUSES between a Decision and a Requirement should additionally be offered as "did you mean GOVERNED_BY?" at write time. That is a heavier change, not measured here.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #625 (squash 42259ba). The unthreaded_cluster message now states "THE EDGES THAT THREAD, and the only ones" (heal.rs on origin/main), pinned by the I13 test. Its change record, chg:a-finding-or-refusal-names-the-route-that-works, is in the committed design, not this live store. The write-time "did you mean GOVERNED_BY?" in ⑨ was not built.
